cfg.raw_spark: A tool for freelance designers because Moneybird's payment reminders only go out after an invoice is already two weeks overdue.

answers.m2: Two Fridays ago Sanne opened Moneybird, saw the reminder for the Bakker invoice had only just gone out on day 15, and called the client herself while it was still on screen.
answers.m3: My colleague Jordan, another freelance designer, told me last month he now sends his own manual reminder on day three because he can't wait two weeks for the system to catch it.
answers.m4: Priya, a bookkeeper I met at a workshop, keeps a spreadsheet that flags anything unpaid after a week. For her the pain is matching payments to invoices, the reminder timing part is fine.
answers.m5: Sanne uses Moneybird's built-in reminder schedule, but it only fires at the two-week mark, so by then the client has already forgotten the invoice existed.
answers.m6: "I am done chasing money like it's my fault," she said after the Bakker one.
answers.m7: Owen does retainer illustration work for two agencies. Late payments cost him nothing because the retainer bills monthly whether projects ship or not.
